categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Sanchao Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of superhard material tools and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Its main products include electroplated diamond wire and diamond grinding wheels, which are used for precision cutting, grinding, and polishing of hard and brittle materials such as silicon, sapphire, magnetic materials, and semiconductor wafers. The company also develops specialized equipment for the photovoltaic and semiconductor industries, including silicon rod grinding centers and wafer thinning machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced electroplating technology to produce diamond wires with diamond particles bonded onto metal wires, mainly tungsten wires for finer diameters and higher tensile strength. It also develops diamond grinding wheels with various bonding agents (resin, metal, ceramic, electroplated) tailored for different applications. The production involves precision manufacturing to ensure uniform diamond distribution and tight diameter control. The company invests heavily in R&D, holding numerous patents and continuously innovating in materials, bonding agents, and manufacturing processes to improve product performance and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in the photovoltaic industry (e.g., LONGi Green Energy, GCL, TCL Zhonghuan), sapphire industry (e.g., Sanan Optoelectronics, Crystal-Optoelectronics), magnetic materials industry (e.g., Xiamen TDK, Hengdian Dongci), semiconductor packaging and testing companies (e.g., HuaRun Microelectronics, Changdian Technology), and carbon silicon enterprises (e.g., BYD). The products serve markets involving silicon wafer slicing, sapphire cutting, magnetic material processing, semiconductor chip manufacturing, and precision equipment for photovoltaic and semiconductor sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Jiangsu Province (Nanjing, Jurong, Huai'an). It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Japan (Kabushiki Kaisha SCD) focused on R&D and technical support. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 96% of revenue, with a small portion of exports. The company aims to expand its international market presence through overseas distributors and agents.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Sanchao operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing precision superhard material tools and semiconductor processing equipment used by downstream manufacturers in photovoltaic, semiconductor, sapphire, and magnetic material industries. It procures raw materials such as synthetic diamond powder, tungsten wire, nickel, and aluminum substrates from upstream suppliers and delivers finished cutting tools and equipment to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment to maintain technological leadership and product differentiation. Key R&D directions include developing finer and more efficient diamond wires, advanced bonding agents for grinding wheels, semiconductor chip processing tools (e.g., CMP disks, thinning wheels), and semiconductor manufacturing equipment (e.g., wafer thinning machines, chamfering machines). It also focuses on cost reduction, product quality improvement, and expanding applications into emerging fields like third-generation semiconductors and Mini/Micro LED sapphire substrates.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products, including diamond wires, diamond grinding wheels, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The company also uses consignment sales for some customers. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control of goods or completion of equipment installation and acceptance. The company offers credit terms typically ranging from 3 to 6 months to downstream customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanjing Sanchao is one of the earliest and leading domestic manufacturers of diamond wires and diamond grinding wheels in China, with significant market share and recognized brand reputation. It competes with international suppliers from Japan, South Korea, and the USA, especially in high-end semiconductor diamond tools. The company has contributed to national industry standards and holds a strong position in silicon wafer slicing and semiconductor chip processing consumables. However, it faces intensified competition due to industry capacity expansion and price pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 348.8 million, a 27.5% decline year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 140.9 million, reflecting a significant downturn due to market fluctuations and asset impairment. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 972 million, with net assets of RMB 658 million. Despite recent losses, the company continues to invest over 10% of revenue in R&D and maintains steady cash flow from operations. It has adjusted capacity expansion plans in response to market conditions and aims for stable growth through innovation and market diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and precision manufacturing expertise to deliver high-quality, cost-effective superhard material tools tailored for hard and brittle materials. Its diamond wires and grinding wheels offer superior cutting efficiency, durability, and fine specifications (e.g., ultra-fine tungsten wire diameters) that enhance yield and reduce material loss in photovoltaic and semiconductor applications. The integrated product system, including complementary diamond tools and semiconductor equipment, creates synergistic value for customers. The company also highlights its stable relationships with leading industry players and its role in setting industry standards as key competitive advantages.
